note.en: A 2 mm vitrinellid snail listed for the Costa Rican Caribbean; the museum record here is a fossil.
note.es: Un caracol vitrinélido de 2 mm listado para el Caribe de Costa Rica; el registro de museo aquí es un fósil.

evidence: GBIF: 1 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399

recWhy: Only the Costa Rican Caribbean catalogue; the museum record in the region is a fossil.
